test.create_query: CREATE TABLE phrase_perf_dense (text String, INDEX idx(text) TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, positions = 1) GRANULARITY 1000000) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS allow_experimental_text_index_positions = 1

CREATE TABLE phrase_perf_sparse (text String, INDEX idx(text) TYPE text(tokenizer = splitByNonAlpha, positions = 1) GRANULARITY 1000000) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple() SETTINGS allow_experimental_text_index_positions = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO phrase_perf_dense SELECT arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> toString(rand(number * 64 + x) % 32), range(64)), ' ') FROM numbers(500000)
INSERT INTO phrase_perf_sparse SELECT arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> toString(rand(number * 64 + x) % 1000000), range(64)), ' ') FROM numbers(500000)
test.query: SELECT count() FROM phrase_perf_dense WHERE hasPhrase(text, '10 20')
